admin.title: Floating Ads
admin.description: Manage defaults, ad images, and date/time reservations in one screen.
admin.combine_success: Selected ads were combined into a carousel.
admin.combine_min: Select at least two ads to combine.
admin.combine_unavailable: Run php artisan migrate before combining ads into a carousel.
admin.extra_urls_hint: Add more image URLs, one per row.
admin.combine_on_create_hint: Newly created images share one carousel group.
admin.combine_hint: Select ads in the list, then combine them into one carousel sequence.
admin.edit_loaded: Loaded the selected ad into the form.
admin.image_url_hint: Enter a public image URL (https://... or /storage/...).
admin.image_file_hint: Choose one or more jpg, png, gif, or webp files (max 10MB each).
admin.source_hint: Choose either file upload or an image URL. Only one applies.
admin.reset_closed_success: Visitor close records were invalidated, so ads will show again.
admin.reset_closed_hint: Close state is stored per browser in a cookie and localStorage. This button changes the cookie key so ads show again for everyone.
admin.close_cookie_key_hint: To test a single browser, clear this key from cookies and localStorage in DevTools.
admin.settings_hint: These values apply when reservations are off, and as defaults for new reservation rows.
admin.offset_px_hint: Left/right: from the content box edge. Positive = outward into the side margin, negative = inward over the content. Top/bottom: from the viewport edge (negative = off-screen direction).
admin.vertical_align_hint: Applies to left/right ads. Top/bottom positions stay horizontally centered on the viewport.
admin.vertical_offset_px_hint: Top: px from the viewport top (negative = up). Bottom: px from the viewport bottom (negative = down). Middle: nudge from center (positive = down, negative = up).
admin.schedules_enabled_hint: When on, every matching reservation below is applied. Different positions show at the same time. If none match, ads are hidden.
admin.schedules_hint: Add multiple windows. Turn a row off to skip it. All days on or empty means every day.
admin.schedules_multi_position_hint: Add several reservations in the same time window with different positions to show ads in more than one place at once.
admin.item_ids_hint: Leave empty to show all currently enabled ads.
admin.row_settings_hint: Override position, size, and carousel options for this window. Matching rows with different positions show together.
admin.carousel_options_hint: Applies when two or more slides are shown. A single ad hides the buttons and dots.

stats.title: Floating ad stats
stats.description: Impressions and clicks by ad, by page, and by ad × page.
stats.hint: Impressions are counted once per ad per page per session. Clicks are counted every time.
stats.empty: No stats in this range yet. Counts appear after ads are shown.
